summary: The root YTM primarily means to make someone an orphan, specifically by causing them to lose their father. This action renders a child fatherless.
lane: 4 أَيْتَمَهُ ذ [ He made him fatherless ]. (TA in art. ايم .) See an ex. in art. ايم , conj. 2.
